title: The Girl From The Farm — EN/FR/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar French German language learning warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe-Australia character portrait honest practical
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
She grew up where distances are real.
Practical in the way that people are practical when they've always had to be.
The girl from the farm — Kerri — exactly right.
Red dust in Australia — still on her shoes somehow.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Elle a grandi là où les distances sont réelles. (She grew up where distances are real.)
Pratique de la façon dont les gens le sont quand ils ont toujours dû l'être. (Practical the way people are when they've always had to be.)
La fille de la ferme — Kerri — exactement juste. (The girl from the farm — Kerri — exactly right.)
Poussière rouge en Australie — encore sur ses chaussures d'une certaine façon. (Red dust in Australia — still on her shoes somehow.)

[Chorus - German, with English translations]
Das Mädchen von der Farm (The girl from the farm)
Jetzt die Frau mit der Familie (Now the woman with the family)
Das Mädchen von der Farm (The girl from the farm)
Die Simbabwe nach Australien brachte (Who brought Zimbabwe to Australia)
Das Mädchen von der Farm (The girl from the farm)
Kerri — die von Jeff und Jill kommt (Kerri — who came from Jeff and Jill)
In der roten Staubgewissheit aufgewachsen (Who grew up in the red dust certainty)
Und ist noch genau so (And is still exactly that)

[Bridge - all three]
English: You can trace the line back. It goes straight with this family.
French: Vous pouvez retracer la ligne. Elle va toujours droite avec cette famille. (You can trace the line. Always straight with this family.)
German: Sie können die Linie zurückverfolgen. Sie geht immer gerade mit dieser Familie. (You can trace the line. Always straight with this family.)

[Outro - all three]
English: The girl from the farm is home now
French: La fille de la ferme est à la maison maintenant (The girl from the farm is home now)
German: Das Mädchen von der Farm ist jetzt zu Hause (The girl from the farm is home now)
